annotations.title: Martingale Time Invariance via setIntegral_eq
annotations.body: **Core insight**: E[f_n] = E[f_0] is proved using `Martingale.setIntegral_eq` with `s = Set.univ`, rather than the Optional Stopping Theorem directly. This bypasses the `τ : Ω → ℕ∞` API complexity. The proof is: `hf.setIntegral_eq (Nat.zero_le n) MeasurableSet.univ`, then `simp only [Measure.restrict_univ]`.

annotations.title: Gambler's Ruin Formula (Algebraic)
annotations.body: The key step: from `p * (W₀ + a) = W₀` (the fair game condition), we derive `p = W₀/(W₀+a)` by dividing both sides by `W₀ + a`. This requires only `rw [eq_div_iff hWa]; linarith` — the Optional Stopping Theorem has already done the hard work by establishing E[final wealth] = E[initial wealth].

annotations.title: Axiom Elimination via Mathlib iff
annotations.body: The axiom `submartingale_of_stoppedValue_mono` in FairGamesTheorem.lean is the backward direction of Mathlib's `submartingale_iff_expected_stoppedValue_mono`. This theorem eliminates it: `rw [submartingale_iff_expected_stoppedValue_mono hadapt hint]` rewrites the Submartingale goal to the iff's RHS, then `exact h` closes the goal in one step. The hypothesis `h` is stated with ℕ∞ stopping times (the Mathlib 4.26.0 API), unlike the axiom which used ℕ.
annotations.mathContext: E[f_τ] ≤ E[f_π] for all bounded τ≤π (ℕ∞) ↔ Submartingale f

annotations.title: Mathlib 4.26.0 Breaking Change: IsStoppingTime API
annotations.body: During formalization, we discovered that Mathlib 4.26.0 changed `IsStoppingTime` from `τ : Ω → ι` to `τ : Ω → WithTop ι`. This means FairGamesTheorem.lean (written for an older API) has pre-existing build failures. The `stoppedValue` function now uses `WithTop.untopA` for evaluation. Four theorems in this file remain as sorries pending resolution of the `stoppedValue`/`untopA` simp API.
annotations.mathContext: IsStoppingTime ℱ : (Ω → WithTop ℕ) → Prop in Mathlib 4.26.0
